studies.title: Statue of Zeus at Olympia — c. 400 BCE
studies.caption: About 400 BCE. The seated Zeus fills the far end of his temple at Olympia.
studies.prompt: Interior colonnade side view seated chryselephantine Zeus with ivory-toned skin and gold robe, throne, small winged Nike in right hand and staff in left, both arms anatomically coherent, no outdoor standing giant.
